videos.title: Steelworker quits at 50, builds $50K cordwood home lit by colorful bottles
videos.author: Kirsten Dirksen
videos.description:
At 50, Jason Fine walked away from his union boilermaker job and cashed out his retirement to buy 29 acres of cheap land in the Missouri Ozarks. 

He and his wife Sunni moved into a tiny shack on the property and started building their forever home from scratch without buying a single piece of wood.
